message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **47,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s army) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition (Wellington’s army) | ~22,000 |

These figures are based on contemporary reports and modern scholarship; exact numbers vary slightly between sources, but the consensus places total casualties in the mid‑40,000s.
